children.value: > Fact From Story The government argued on November 10 that Google only endeavored to enhance its search engine in the European Union after it was hit by a €5 billion antitrust fine in 2018, internal documents revealed, according to Bloomberg.

> > Fact From Story In response, Google enacted a plan, which execs dubbed “Go Big in Europe,” to enhance search results in France and Germany in 2019 and 2020 with more local content: news, post-game soccer video highlights, information on local television options for streaming, and pronunciation practice for different language.
> > > Fact From Story The aim was to incentivize users to click on Google’s home screen, rather than the competition’s.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Companies are often incentivized to take action to improve their products and services in response to regulatory pressure.
> > Fact From Story The EU’s antitrust order forced Google to offer Android phone users a screen with five search engine options to choose from, according to the DOJ.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Companies are often incentivized to take action to improve their products and services in response to regulatory pressure.
> Commonsense Knowledge Companies are often incentivized to improve their products or services when faced with external pressures such as competition or regulation.
